structured_output.notes: Thin on authoritative sources: The Hindu, ET, Moneycontrol, Mint, HT, BS, New Indian Express, Knight Frank, JLL, Anarock plot data not obtained. Deccan Herald and JLL pages returned 403, and the NSE filing timed out. The Anarock PDF was unreadable. Nearly all price evidence is from broker/portal blogs (asking/analyst estimates). Seen in search snippets but not verified by opening the page, so excluded from claims: Prestige Gardenia Phase 2 (June 2026, ~21 acres, 195 plots, ~Rs 400 crore), KNS Samooha (Nelamangala, 150 acres), Abhee Tranquila (Sarjapur-Attibele Road), Attibele listing rates of ~Rs 1,700-3,500/sqft, the Feb 2026 BDA warning on illegal layouts, the Namma Khate B-to-A scheme (2% fee, deadline 23 Aug 2026), and the Deccan Herald KIADB Devanahalli acquisition at Rs 2.70 crore/acre. Hoskote, Anekal and Nelamangala have no verified claims. Bidadi and Doddaballapur have partial coverage. Conflicting plot-rate figures across sources should be treated as directional only.
